verdict.rationale: Manufact exposes a REST API and an official MCP server, so API versioning and deprecation policy are fair questions for this product. The evidence pack shows no versioned API endpoints and no documented deprecation policy. A changelog exists and a community comment mentions an upcoming mcp-use v2 library, but neither is an API versioning scheme or a deprecation commitment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
